label: Tie the variation stock mode to its quantity

precheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('"public"."Variation"') IS NOT NULL AS ok

execute.description: Drop the quantity of every unlimited variation
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."Variation"
SET "stockQty" = NULL
WHERE "stockMode" = 'unlimited' AND "stockQty" IS NOT NULL

execute.description: Give every controlled variation a quantity
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."Variation"
SET "stockQty" = 0
WHERE "stockMode" = 'controlled' AND "stockQty" IS NULL

postcheck.description: Verify every variation agrees with its stock mode
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM "public"."Variation"
  WHERE ("stockMode" = 'unlimited' AND "stockQty" IS NOT NULL)
     OR ("stockMode" = 'controlled' AND "stockQty" IS NULL)
) AS ok

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."Variation" ADD CONSTRAINT "variation_stock_mode_consistent_e90ad844" CHECK (("stockMode" = 'unlimited' AND "stockQty" IS NULL) OR ("stockMode" = 'controlled' AND "stockQty" IS NOT NULL))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3) AND "c"."contype" = $4)) AS "result"
